propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as offline Jira oracle and passes field values into ObservedJira.PRESENT classification; narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade drift classification without explicit fencing.

When prev_snapshot is narrowed to key-set entries (jira_key: {}), field-based drift classifications should report indeterminate rather than infer from empty dicts, never emitting false drift or failing CLI exit codes.
Membership-only drift buckets (active-bound, missing-local, unbound-present) must remain unchanged and work identically for both key-set and full-payload snapshots.
Full-payload prev_snapshot behavior must be byte-identical to pre-A4-2 behavior; no regression for existing consumers.
bridge_fsck CLI exit code and JSON envelope shape must be unchanged for both key-set and full-payload fixture scenarios.
